title: Traffic-related air pollution to be measured in 50 Bucharest locations as part of European campaign
summary: The Ecopolis Centre for Sustainable Policies will measure nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) concentrations at 50 locations across Bucharest over one month, as part of the European “See What You Breathe” campaign. Using 100 passive sampling tubes, NO₂ levels will be measured in different areas of the city to assess traffic-related air pollution. The campaign is taking place simultaneously in nine EU countries: Bulgaria, Germany, Spain, France, Greece, Italy, Ireland, Poland and Romania. It is coordinated by the Polish Smog Alert association and funded by the Clean Air Fund. Nitrogen dioxide is an invisible pollutant produced mainly by fuel combustion.
